Summary

  • Implements the cch request signing mechanism described in this reverse-engineering article. The cch field in the x-anthropic-billing-header is an xxHash64-based integrity hash over the serialized request body that gates features like fast mode.
  • Adds xxhash-wasm dependency for WebAssembly-based xxHash64 computation — fast, portable, no native bindings required.
  • New src/utils/cch.ts module computes the hash: xxHash64(body_with_placeholder, seed) & 0xFFFFF, formatted as 5-char zero-padded hex.
  • Modified buildFetch in client.ts to intercept /v1/messages requests containing the cch=00000 placeholder, compute the hash, and replace the placeholder before sending.
  • Removed the NATIVE_CLIENT_ATTESTATION feature gate from system.ts so the cch=00000 placeholder is always included in the attribution header. The hash is now computed in JS-land instead of relying on Bun's native HTTP stack.

Algorithm (from the article)

  1. Build the complete request body with cch=00000 as placeholder
  2. Compute xxHash64(body_bytes, seed) & 0xFFFFF (seed: 0x6E52736AC806831E)
  3. Format as zero-padded 5-character lowercase hex
  4. Replace cch=00000 with the computed value in the body

Activation conditions (matching the original Bun native implementation)

  • URL path contains /v1/messages
  • anthropic-version header is present
  • Request body contains the cch=00000 placeholder

Test plan

  • bun run build succeeds
  • bun run build:dev succeeds
  • TypeScript compiles without new errors
  • Manual testing: verify requests to Anthropic API include computed cch value (visible via debug logging)
  • Manual testing: verify fast mode works when authenticated via OAuth

Walkthrough

Adds xxhash-wasm dependency and introduces CCH (Client Challenge Hash) computation to the API client. A new utility module computes CCH values using xxhash64 and replaces placeholders in Anthropic chat request bodies. The system constant now always appends the CCH placeholder, with actual computation deferred to the fetch wrapper during request transmission.

Dependency Addition
package.json		 Adds xxhash-wasm ^1.1.0 as a new dependency for hash computation.
CCH Utility Layer
src/utils/cch.ts		 New module implementing lazily-instantiated xxhash64-based CCH computation with functions to compute CCH, replace placeholders, and detect placeholder presence in request bodies.
System & API Integration
src/constants/system.ts, src/services/api/client.ts		 Removes feature flag conditionals; system constant now unconditionally appends CCH placeholder. Fetch wrapper intercepts Anthropic chat requests, computes CCH asynchronously, and replaces placeholder in request body before transmission.

    CCHUtil->>CCHUtil: Mask & convert to hex

    CCHUtil-->>FetchWrapper: Updated body with actual cch
    FetchWrapper->>Server: Delegated fetch with updated body
    Server-->>FetchWrapper: Response
    FetchWrapper-->>Client: Response
